sw.L: Mwanadamu, siku zake [ni] kama majani; kama ua la shambani, ndivyo anavyostawi,
sw.B: Wanadamu siku zao ni kama majani; wanachanua kama ua la kondeni,
sw.R: Maisha ya mwanadamu ni mafupi, kama majani. Watu huchanua kama maua ya porini.

es.L: {{gender:El ser humano|El hombre}}: como la hierba [son] sus días; \q como la flor del campo, así florece,
es.B: Los mortales tienen días como la hierba; \q florecen como una flor en el campo abierto,
es.R: La vida humana es corta, como la hierba. \q La gente florece como las flores silvestres.

vi.L: Loài người, những ngày của họ [như] cỏ; như hoa ngoài đồng, họ cũng tươi tốt như vậy,
vi.B: Ngày tháng của con người như cỏ; họ nở rộ như bông hoa ngoài đồng trống,
vi.R: Đời người ngắn ngủi như cỏ. Người ta nở rộ như hoa dại.

ko.L: 사람은, 그의 날들이 풀과 같고, 들의 꽃처럼 그렇게 피어나지만,
ko.B: 죽을 인생은 그 날들이 풀과 같아서, 들판의 꽃처럼 피어나지만,
ko.R: 사람의 삶은 풀처럼 짧다. 사람은 들꽃처럼 피어난다.

pt.L: {{gender:O ser humano|O homem}} — como a erva [são] os seus dias; \q como a flor do campo, assim floresce,
pt.B: Os mortais têm dias como a erva; \q florescem como uma flor no campo aberto,
pt.R: A vida humana é curta como o capim. \q As pessoas florescem como flores do campo.

am.L: ሰው፣ ዘመኑ እንደ ሣር [ነው]፤ እንደ ሜዳ አበባ እንዲሁ ያብባል፣
am.B: ሟች ሰዎች ዘመናቸው እንደ ሣር ነው፤ በሜዳ እንዳለ አበባ ያብባሉ፣
am.R: የሰው ሕይወት እንደ ሣር አጭር ነው። ሰዎች እንደ ዱር አበባ ያብባሉ።

hi.L: मनुष्य — उसके दिन घास के समान [हैं]; जैसे मैदान का फूल, वैसे ही वह खिलता है,
hi.B: नश्वर मनुष्यों के दिन घास जैसे हैं; वे खुले मैदान के फूल की तरह खिलते हैं,
hi.R: मनुष्य का जीवन घास की तरह थोड़े दिनों का है। लोग जंगली फूलों की तरह खिलते हैं।

ru.L: Смертный — его дни как трава; как цветок в поле, так он расцветает,
ru.B: Дни смертных подобны траве; они расцветают, как цветок в открытом поле,
ru.R: Жизнь человека коротка, как трава. Люди расцветают, как полевые цветы.

ja.L: 人は、その日々は草のよう。野の花のように、そのように咲く。
ja.B: 人の日々は草のようだ。野に咲く花のように、人は花を開く。
ja.R: 人の命は、草のように短い。人は、野の花のように咲く。

uk.L: Смертна людина — як трава її дні; як польова квітка, так вона квітне,
uk.B: Дні смертних — як трава; вони квітнуть, як квітка у відкритому полі,
uk.R: Людське життя коротке, як трава. Люди розквітають, як польові квіти.

decisions.choice: humankind: human beings, weak and mortal
decisions.reason: The word ('enosh) means a human being, often with a sense of weakness (8:5; 90:3).

decisions.choice: grass, a flower of the field: life that soon fades
decisions.reason: In a dry land grass and wild flowers spring up after rain and wither in days (90:5-6; Isaiah 40:6-8).

decisions.choice: a mortal, their, they flourish (with "man", "his", "he flourishes" as the alternatives)
decisions.reason: The word means any human being (m1), so Literal gives inclusive wording by default with the traditional words as the alternative (8:5); Balanced and Readable say "mortals" and "people".

decisions.choice: the gender setting on the noun only at Literal: "Le mortel" / "L'homme"; "ses" and "il" have no span
alternatives: spans on the pronouns, as the English "their|his", "they flourish|he flourishes"
decisions.reason: French puts the setting on the noun; the possessive and the generic "il" that refer back to it are the same with either noun.

decisions.choice: El ser humano (gender setting); sus, florece (no setting)
decisions.reason: The word 'enosh means any human being. Literal says "El ser humano" with "El hombre" as the traditional alternative; "sus días" and "florece" already fit either, so they need no setting.

decisions.choice: "loài người" and "họ" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "loài người" already means all human beings, men and women, so Vietnamese has no second form for the English gender setting to switch to.

decisions.choice: "사람" and "그" with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in 90:3: the word means human beings, weak and mortal (meaning decision m1), and Korean "사람" already includes everyone.

decisions.choice: {{gender:O ser humano|O homem}}, with "seus" and "floresce" outside the span
decisions.reason: The English Literal needs three spans (r-en-1). In Portuguese the singular noun carries the choice, and "seus" and "floresce" read the same with either option, so one span does.

decisions.choice: "ሰው", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "a mortal" or "man". Amharic "ሰው" already means a human being, man or woman, so there is no second wording to offer.

decisions.choice: "मनुष्य", "उसके", "वह" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Where the English Literal has "A mortal|Man", "their|his" and "they flourish|he flourishes", Hindi "मनुष्य" already means any human being and "उसके", "वह" are not marked for gender, so the Hindi needs no span (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: "Смертный ... его ... он", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "A mortal, their, they" with "Man, his, he" as the alternative (m1). Russian "смертный" already means any human being, and its pronouns are the ordinary generic ones, so there is no second wording for a span to choose, as with "человек".

decisions.choice: 'enosh "人" with no gender span; "その日々", "咲く" with no pronoun
decisions.reason: The English L has a gender span (a mortal / man); Japanese 人 is already inclusive and needs no pronoun, so there is no span.

source.text: כִּ֤י ר֣וּחַ עָֽבְרָה־בּ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְלֹא־יַכִּירֶ֖נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: for a wind passes over it, and it is not, and its place does not recognize it again.

en.L: for a wind passes over it, and it is not, \q and its place no longer knows it.
en.B: a wind blows across it and it has vanished; \q its own place will not know it again.
en.R: Then the hot wind blows over them, and they are gone. \q No one even remembers where they were.

fr.L: car un vent passe sur elle, et elle n’est plus, \q et son lieu ne la reconnaît plus.
fr.B: un vent souffle sur elle, et elle a disparu ; \q le lieu où elle était ne la reconnaîtra plus.
fr.R: Puis le vent chaud souffle sur eux, et ils ne sont plus là. \q Personne ne se souvient même de l’endroit où ils étaient.

sw.L: kwa maana upepo unapita juu yake, nalo halipo, wala mahali pake hapalitambui tena.
sw.B: upepo unavuma juu yake nalo limetoweka; hata mahali pake hapatalijua tena.
sw.R: Kisha upepo wa joto unavuma juu yao, nao wanatoweka. Hakuna hata anayekumbuka walipokuwa.

es.L: porque pasa el viento sobre ella, y ya no está, \q y su lugar no la conoce más.
es.B: sopla el viento sobre ella y ha desaparecido; \q su propio lugar ya no la reconocerá.
es.R: Luego sopla el viento caliente sobre ellos, y desaparecen. \q Nadie se acuerda siquiera de dónde estaban.

vi.L: vì một cơn gió thổi qua nó, và nó không còn nữa, và chỗ của nó không còn nhận biết nó nữa.
vi.B: gió thổi qua là nó biến mất; chính chỗ nó mọc cũng chẳng còn biết đến nó.
vi.R: Rồi cơn gió nóng thổi qua, và họ không còn nữa. Thậm chí không ai còn nhớ họ đã ở đâu.

ko.L: 바람이 그 위로 지나가면 그것은 없어지고, 그 자리도 다시 그것을 알지 못한다.
ko.B: 바람이 그 위로 불고 지나가면 사라져 버리고, 그 있던 자리조차 그것을 다시 알아보지 못한다.
ko.R: 그러다가 뜨거운 바람이 불어오면 사라지고 만다. 그들이 어디 있었는지 기억하는 사람조차 없다.

pt.L: porque um vento passa sobre ela, e ela não [existe mais], \q e o seu lugar não a conhece mais.
pt.B: um vento sopra sobre ela, e ela desaparece; \q o seu próprio lugar não a reconhecerá mais.
pt.R: Depois o vento quente sopra sobre elas, e elas somem. \q Ninguém nem se lembra de onde elas estavam.

am.L: ነፋስ ያልፍበታልና፤ ደግሞም የለም፤ ስፍራውም ዳግመኛ አያውቀውም።
am.B: ነፋስ ሲነፍስበት ይጠፋል፤ የነበረበትም ስፍራ ዳግመኛ አያውቀውም።
am.R: ከዚያም የሚያቃጥል ነፋስ ይነፍስባቸዋል፤ እነርሱም ይጠፋሉ። የነበሩበትን ስፍራ እንኳ የሚያስታውስ የለም።

hi.L: क्योंकि हवा उस पर से बह जाती है, और वह नहीं रहता, और उसका स्थान उसे फिर नहीं पहचानता।
hi.B: हवा उस पर से होकर निकलती है और वह मिट जाता है; उसकी अपनी जगह भी उसे फिर नहीं पहचानती।
hi.R: फिर गर्म लू उन पर चलती है, और वे मिट जाते हैं। किसी को याद भी नहीं रहता कि वे कहाँ थे।

ru.L: ведь подует на него ветер — и его не стало, и его место больше его не знает.
ru.B: ветер пронесётся над ним — и он исчез; даже его собственное место не вспомнит о нём.
ru.R: Потом над ними подует горячий ветер, и их уже нет. Никто даже не помнит, где они были.

ja.L: 風がその上を過ぎると、それはもうない。その場所も、もはやそれを知らない。
ja.B: 風がその上を吹き渡ると、それは消えうせ、その元の場所さえ、もうそれを知らない。
ja.R: 熱い風が吹きつけると、人はいなくなってしまう。その人がどこにいたのかさえ、だれも覚えていない。

uk.L: бо вітер пройде над нею, і її немає, і її місце більше не знає її.
uk.B: повіє над нею вітер — і її вже нема; навіть її місце не впізнає її знову.
uk.R: Потім над ними повіє гарячий вітер, і їх уже немає. Ніхто навіть не памʼятає, де вони були.

decisions.choice: a wind: the hot desert wind
decisions.reason: The burning east wind from the desert can wither plants in a day (Isaiah 40:7; Ezekiel 17:10).

decisions.choice: its place does not know it: no trace is left
decisions.reason: The place where it grew does not recognize it again: it is gone without trace (Job 7:10).

decisions.choice: the hot wind; them
decisions.reason: Readable names the kind of wind (m1) and speaks of the people the flowers stand for.

decisions.choice: "गर्म लू"
decisions.reason: The wind is the hot desert wind (meaning m1); Hindi "लू" is exactly that wind, which Readable names as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "熱い風" (R); "その人がどこにいたのかさえ、だれも覚えていない" (R)
decisions.reason: The wind is the hot desert wind (m1); its place not knowing it means no trace is left (m2). R explains both, as the English R.

source.text: וְחֶ֤סֶד יְהוָ֨ה׀מֵעוֹלָ֣ם וְעַד־ע֭וֹלָם עַל־יְרֵאָ֑יו וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ לִבְנֵ֥י בָנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: But [the] loyal love of YHWH [is] from everlasting and to everlasting on [those] fearing him, and his righteousness to children of children,

en.L: But the loyal love of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} righteousness to children's children,
en.B: But the loyal love of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lasts from age to age on all who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q while {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} righteousness reaches their children's children,
en.R: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s faithful love lasts forever and ever for people who honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q He will do what is right for their grandchildren too.

fr.L: Mais l’amour loyal {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] d’éternité en éternité sur ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} justice pour les enfants des enfants,
fr.B: Mais l’amour fidèle {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dure d’âge en âge sur tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} justice s’étend jusqu’aux enfants de leurs enfants,
fr.R: Mais l’amour fidèle {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dure pour toujours et à jamais pour ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorent. \q Il fera aussi ce qui est juste pour leurs petits-enfants.

sw.L: Lakini upendo usiokoma wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] tangu milele hata milele juu ya wale wamchao, na haki {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa watoto wa watoto,
sw.B: Lakini upendo usiokoma wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} unadumu tangu zama hadi zama juu ya wote wamchao, nayo haki {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} inawafikia wajukuu wao,
sw.R: Lakini upendo usiokoma wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} unadumu milele na milele kwa watu wanaomheshimu. Atawatendea haki hata wajukuu wao.

es.L: Pero el amor leal {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [es] desde la eternidad y hasta la eternidad sobre los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} temen, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} justicia para los hijos de los hijos,
es.B: Pero el amor fiel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} dura de una época a otra sobre todos los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} temen, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} justicia alcanza a los hijos de sus hijos,
es.R: Pero el amor fiel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} dura por siempre jamás para la gente que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} honra. \q Él hará lo que es justo también con sus nietos.

vi.L: Nhưng tình yêu thương thành tín của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] từ đời đời cho đến đời đời trên những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [đến] con cháu của con cháu họ,
vi.B: Nhưng tình yêu thương thành tín của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} còn từ đời nọ sang đời kia trên mọi người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến với con cháu của con cháu họ,
vi.R: Nhưng tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} còn mãi mãi đời đời cho những người tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài cũng sẽ làm điều ngay thẳng cho cháu chắt của họ.

ko.L: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 한결같은 사랑은 영원부터 영원까지 그분을 경외하는 이들 위에 [있고], 그분의 의는 자손의 자손에게 [이르니],
ko.B: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 한결같은 사랑은 대대로 영원히 그분을 경외하는 이들 위에 머물고, 그분의 의는 그들의 자손의 자손에게까지 이르니,
ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 변함없는 사랑은 그분을 높이는 사람들에게 영원토록 이어진다. 그분께서는 그들의 손자 손녀들에게도 옳은 일을 해 주실 것이다.

pt.L: Mas o amor leal {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [é] desde a eternidade até a eternidade sobre os que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} temem, \q e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} justiça para os filhos dos filhos,
pt.B: Mas o amor leal {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dura de era em era sobre todos os que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} temem, \q e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} justiça alcança os filhos dos filhos deles,
pt.R: Mas o amor fiel {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dura para todo o sempre para as pessoas que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} honram. \q Ele vai fazer o que é certo também para os netos delas.

am.L: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ጽኑ ፍቅር ግን ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም በሚፈሩት ላይ [ነው]፤ ጽድቁም ለልጅ ልጆች፣
am.B: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ጽኑ ፍቅር ግን በሚፈሩት ሁሉ ላይ ከዘመን እስከ ዘመን ይኖራል፤ ጽድቁም እስከ ልጅ ልጆቻቸው ይደርሳል፣
am.R: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ጽኑ ፍቅር ግን እርሱን ለሚያከብሩ ሰዎች ለዘላለም ይኖራል። ለልጅ ልጆቻቸውም ትክክል የሆነውን ያደርጋል።

hi.L: पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का अटल प्रेम उनका भय माननेवालों पर अनादि काल से अनन्त काल तक [है], और उनकी धार्मिकता सन्तान की सन्तान तक,
hi.B: पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का अटल प्रेम युग-युग तक उन सब पर बना रहता है जो उनका भय मानते हैं, और उनकी धार्मिकता उनके नाती-पोतों तक पहुँचती है,
hi.R: पर जो लोग {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आदर करते हैं, उनके लिए उनका अटल प्रेम सदा-सर्वदा बना रहता है। वे उनके पोते-पोतियों के लिए भी वही करेंगे जो सही है।

ru.L: Но неизменная любовь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} — от века и до века на боящихся {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} праведность — на детях детей,
ru.B: Но неизменная любовь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} пребывает из века в век на всех, кто боится {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, а {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} праведность простирается на детей их детей,
ru.R: А неизменная любовь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} длится вечно для людей, которые почитают {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. Он поступит по справедливости и с их внуками.

ja.L: しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の誠実は、とこしえからとこしえまで、その方を恐れる者たちの上に[あり]、その方の義は子らの子らに[及ぶ]。
ja.B: しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の変わらぬいつくしみは、とこしえからとこしえまで、その方を畏れる人々の上にあり、その方の義は子の子にまで及ぶ。
ja.R: しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の変わらぬいつくしみは、その方をおそれ敬う人々のために、いつまでも続く。その方は、彼らの孫たちにも、正しいことをしてくださる。

uk.L: Але незмінна любов {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} — від віку й до віку на тих, хто боїться {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} праведність — на дітях дітей,
uk.B: Але незмінна любов {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} триває з віку у вік на всіх, хто боїться {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, а {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} праведність сягає дітей їхніх дітей,
uk.R: Але вірна любов {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} триває на віки вічні для людей, які шанують {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}. Він чинитиме правильно і для їхніх онуків.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8).

decisions.choice: from everlasting to everlasting: unlike human days
decisions.reason: Human life is as short as grass (verses 15-16); God's love has no beginning and no end (90:2), and it reaches the generations to come (Exodus 20:6).

decisions.choice: his righteousness: his faithful saving acts
decisions.reason: God's righteousness (tsedaqah) here is his faithfulness in doing right by his people, as in verse 6.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: honor him
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "honor" for the fear that is reverence and trust (25:14), not terror.

decisions.choice: tsidqato "その方の義" (L, B); R "正しいことをしてくださる"
decisions.reason: His righteousness is his faithful saving acts (m3), in the Psalter's forms (義 L, B; R by sense).

source.text: לְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י בְרִית֑וֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵ֥י פִ֝קֻּדָ֗יו לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: to [those who] keep his covenant and to [those who] remember his precepts to do them.

en.L: to those who keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant \q and to those who remember {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} precepts, to do them.
en.B: for all who hold to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant \q and are careful to carry out what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commands.
en.R: That love is for people who are faithful to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant \q and remember to do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says.

fr.L: pour ceux qui gardent {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance \q et pour ceux qui se souviennent de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} préceptes, pour les accomplir.
fr.B: pour tous ceux qui restent attachés à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance \q et veillent à faire ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ordonne.
fr.R: Cet amour est pour ceux qui restent fidèles à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance \q et qui pensent à faire ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit.

sw.L: kwa wale walishikao agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} na kwa wale wayakumbukao maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ili kuyatenda.
sw.B: kwa wote wanaolishika agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} na kuwa waangalifu kutenda yale anayoamuru.
sw.R: Upendo huo ni kwa ajili ya watu walio waaminifu kwa agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} na wanaokumbuka kutenda anayosema.

es.L: para los que guardan {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto \q y para los que se acuerdan de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} preceptos para cumplirlos.
es.B: para todos los que se mantienen fieles a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto \q y se esfuerzan por cumplir lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} manda.
es.R: Ese amor es para la gente que es fiel a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto \q y se acuerda de hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice.

vi.L: cho những người giữ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và những người nhớ các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để làm theo.
vi.B: cho mọi người giữ vững giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và cẩn thận làm theo những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} truyền dạy.
vi.R: Tình thương ấy dành cho những người trung thành với giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nhớ làm theo lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán.

ko.L: 곧 그분의 언약을 지키는 이들과 그분의 법도를 기억하여 행하는 이들에게 [이른다].
ko.B: 곧 그분의 언약을 굳게 지키고 그분께서 명하신 것을 잊지 않고 행하는 모든 이들에게 이른다.
ko.R: 그 사랑은 그분의 언약에 충실하고 그분의 말씀을 기억하여 행하는 사람들에게 주어진다.

pt.L: para os que guardam a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança \q e para os que se lembram dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} preceitos, para cumpri-los.
pt.B: para todos os que se apegam à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança \q e cuidam de pôr em prática o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ordena.
pt.R: Esse amor é para as pessoas que são fiéis à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança \q e se lembram de fazer o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz.

am.L: ቃል ኪዳኑን ለሚጠብቁ፣ ያደርጓቸውም ዘንድ መመሪያዎቹን ለሚያስቡ።
am.B: ቃል ኪዳኑን አጥብቀው ለሚይዙና ያዘዘውን በጥንቃቄ ለሚፈጽሙ ሁሉ ነው።
am.R: ይህ ፍቅር ለቃል ኪዳኑ ታማኝ ለሆኑና የሚለውን ለማድረግ ለሚያስታውሱ ሰዎች ነው።

hi.L: उन पर जो उनकी वाचा का पालन करते हैं, और उन पर जो उनके आदेशों को पूरा करने के लिए उन्हें स्मरण रखते हैं।
hi.B: उन सब पर जो उनकी वाचा को थामे रहते हैं और ध्यान से वही करते हैं जिसकी वे आज्ञा देते हैं।
hi.R: यह प्रेम उन लोगों के लिए है जो उनकी वाचा के प्रति वफ़ादार रहते हैं और जो वे कहते हैं उसे करना याद रखते हैं।

ru.L: на хранящих {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} завет и помнящих {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} повеления, чтобы исполнять их.
ru.B: на всех, кто держится {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} завета и старательно исполняет то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} повелевает.
ru.R: Эта любовь — для людей, которые верны {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} завету и не забывают исполнять то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорит.

ja.L: [すなわち、]その方の契約を守る者たち、その方の命令を覚えて、それを行う者たちに。
ja.B: それは、その方の契約を堅く守り、その方の命令を心に留めて行う人々に及ぶ。
ja.R: その愛は、その方の契約に忠実に従い、その方が命じられることを忘れずに行う人々のためのものだ。

uk.L: на тих, хто зберігає {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} завіт, і на тих, хто памʼятає {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} накази, щоб виконувати їх.
uk.B: на всіх, хто тримається {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} завіту й дбає виконувати те, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наказує.
uk.R: Ця любов — для людей, які вірні {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} завітові й не забувають робити те, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} каже.

decisions.choice: precepts: instructions, charges
decisions.reason: The word (piqqudim) is used only in the Psalms, of God's specific instructions (19:9; 119:4).

decisions.choice: love and the covenant
decisions.reason: God's lasting love is given to those who keep faith with him in the covenant, remembering his words in order to live by them (Deuteronomy 7:9).

decisions.choice: 103:17 is closed and 103:18 picks it up with "[すなわち、]" (L), "それは" (B), "その愛は" (R); piqqudim "命令" (L, B), "その方が命じられること" (R), as the Psalm 119 table
decisions.reason: The Hebrew runs on from 103:17; Japanese closes the verse and resumes, keeping each verse's content after its own marker.

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה בַּ֭שָּׁמַיִם הֵכִ֣ין כִּסְא֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכוּת֗וֹ בַּכֹּ֥ל מָשָֽׁלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH in the heavens has established his throne, and his kingdom over all rules.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has established {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne in the heavens, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} kingdom rules over all.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has fixed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne in heaven; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} royal power reigns over all there is.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has made heaven the place of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne. \q He is King over everything.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a établi {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône dans les cieux, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} royauté domine sur tout.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dressé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône dans le ciel ; \q {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} pouvoir royal règne sur tout ce qui existe.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait du ciel le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône. \q Il est roi sur toutes choses.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekiweka imara kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi mbinguni, na ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unatawala juu ya yote.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekisimika kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi mbinguni; mamlaka {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ya kifalme yanatawala juu ya kila kilichopo.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameifanya mbingu kuwa mahali pa kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi. Yeye ni Mfalme juu ya kila kitu.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha establecido {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono en los cielos, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reino domina sobre todo.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha afirmado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono en el cielo; \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder real reina sobre todo lo que existe.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho del cielo el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono. \q Él es Rey sobre todas las cosas.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã lập ngôi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên các tầng trời, và vương quốc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cai trị trên muôn vật.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đặt vững ngôi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên trời; quyền vương của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cai trị mọi loài.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đặt ngôi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên trời. Ngài là Vua trên mọi sự.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하늘에 그분의 왕좌를 세우셨고, 그분의 나라가 만물을 다스린다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하늘에 그분의 왕좌를 굳게 세우셨으니, 그분의 왕권이 온 세상을 다스린다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하늘에 그분의 왕좌를 두셨다. 그분은 모든 것을 다스리시는 왕이시다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} firmou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trono nos céus, \q e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} reinado governa sobre todas as coisas.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fixou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trono no céu; \q o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder real reina sobre tudo o que existe.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fez do céu o lugar do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trono. \q Ele é Rei sobre todas as coisas.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ዙፋኑን በሰማያት አጸና፤ መንግሥቱም ሁሉን ትገዛለች።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ዙፋኑን በሰማይ መሠረተ፤ ንጉሣዊ ሥልጣኑም በሁሉ ላይ ይገዛል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሰማይን የዙፋኑ ስፍራ አደረገ። እርሱ የሁሉ ነገር ንጉሥ ነው።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने स्वर्ग में अपना सिंहासन स्थिर किया है, और उनका राज्य सब पर प्रभुता करता है।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने स्वर्ग में अपना सिंहासन अटल रूप से रखा है; उनका राजसी अधिकार सारी सृष्टि पर चलता है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने स्वर्ग को अपने सिंहासन का स्थान बनाया है। वे सब कुछ के राजा हैं।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} утвердил на небесах свой престол, и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} царство владычествует над всем.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} воздвиг свой престол на небе; {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} царская власть простирается на всё, что есть.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделал небо местом своего престола. Он — Царь над всем.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は天にご自分の王座を据えられ、その方の王権はすべてを治める。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は天に王座を堅く据えられた。その王としての支配は、あらゆるものに及ぶ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、天をご自分の王座の場所とされた。その方は、すべてのものの王だ。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} утвердив свій престол на небесах, і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} царство панує над усім.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} міцно поставив свій престол на небі; {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} царська влада панує над усім, що існує.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зробив небо місцем свого престолу. Він — Цар над усім.

decisions.choice: his kingdom over all: the LORD as King
decisions.reason: The call to praise in verses 20-22 rests on this: the LORD is King of everything, in heaven and on earth (93:1; 97:1).

source.text: בָּרֲכ֥וּ יְהוָ֗ה מַלְאָ֫כָ֥יו גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹ֭חַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Bless YHWH, his angels, mighty [ones] of strength, doing his word, by obeying the voice of his word.

en.L: Bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, [you] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} angels, \q mighty in strength, who do {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word, \q obeying the voice of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word.
en.B: Bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you angels of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}, \q strong warriors who carry out what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says \q and listen for the sound of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word.
en.R: Angels of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! \q You are strong and powerful. \q You do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says. You obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} every word.

fr.L: Bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [vous] {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} anges, \q puissants en force, qui accomplissez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole, \q en obéissant à la voix de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole.
fr.B: Bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} anges, \q guerriers puissants qui exécutez ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit \q et qui êtes attentifs au son de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole.
fr.R: Anges {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ! \q Vous êtes forts et puissants. Vous faites ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit. \q Vous obéissez à chacune de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles.

sw.L: Mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, [enyi] malaika {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, mlio hodari kwa nguvu, mnaotenda neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, mkiitii sauti ya neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.B: Mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi malaika {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, mashujaa wenye nguvu mnaotekeleza anayosema na kuisikiliza sauti ya neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Enyi malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, msifuni! Mna nguvu na uweza. Mnafanya anayosema. Mnatii kila neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Bendigan|Bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ángeles, \q poderosos en fuerza, que cumplen {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra, \q obedeciendo la voz de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra.
es.B: {{plural_you:Bendigan|Bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, ángeles {{deity_pronoun:suyos|Suyos}}, \q guerreros fuertes que hacen lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice \q y escuchan atentos el sonido de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra.
es.R: Ángeles {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}}! \q {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} fuertes y poderosos. \q {{plural_you:Hacen|Hacéis}} lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice. {{plural_you:Obedecen|Obedecéis}} cada una de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras.

vi.L: Hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi các thiên sứ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là những đấng đầy sức mạnh, làm theo lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vâng theo tiếng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hỡi các thiên sứ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi những chiến binh hùng mạnh, là những đấng thực hiện điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán và lắng nghe tiếng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Hỡi các thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Các vị thật mạnh mẽ và đầy quyền năng. Các vị làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán. Các vị vâng theo từng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라, 그분의 천사들아, 힘이 강한 용사들아, 그분의 말씀을 행하며 그분 말씀의 소리를 듣고 따르는 이들아.
ko.B: 그분의 천사들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라. 그분의 말씀을 이루고 그분 말씀의 소리에 귀 기울이는 힘센 용사들아.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사들아, 그분을 찬양하여라! 너희는 강하고 힘이 있다. 너희는 그분께서 말씀하시는 대로 행한다. 그분의 모든 말씀에 순종한다.

pt.L: Bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, [vocês,] os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} anjos, \q poderosos em força, que cumprem a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra, \q obedecendo à voz da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra.
pt.B: Bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, vocês, anjos {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, \q guerreiros fortes que fazem o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz \q e ficam atentos ao som da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra.
pt.R: Anjos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, louvem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}}! \q Vocês são fortes e poderosos. Vocês fazem o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz. \q Vocês obedecem a cada palavra {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ፤ እናንተ በኃይል ብርቱዎች የሆናችሁ መላእክቱ፣ የቃሉን ድምፅ እየሰማችሁ ቃሉን የምትፈጽሙ።
am.B: እናንተ ቃሉን የምትፈጽሙና የቃሉን ድምፅ የምታደምጡ ብርቱ ተዋጊዎች መላእክቱ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ።
am.R: እናንተ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} መላእክት፣ አመስግኑት! እናንተ ብርቱዎችና ኃያላን ናችሁ። የሚላችሁን ታደርጋላችሁ። ቃሉን ሁሉ ትታዘዛላችሁ።

hi.L: हे उनके स्वर्गदूतो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो, [तुम] जो बल में सामर्थी हो, जो उनके वचन को पूरा करते हो, और उनके वचन की आवाज़ मानते हो।
hi.B: हे उनके स्वर्गदूतो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो, तुम बलवान योद्धा जो उनका कहा पूरा करते हो और उनके वचन की आवाज़ पर कान लगाए रहते हो।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के स्वर्गदूतो, उनकी स्तुति करो! तुम बलवान और शक्तिशाली हो। तुम वही करते हो जो वे कहते हैं। तुम उनकी हर बात मानते हो।

ru.L: Благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, [вы,] {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ангелы, сильные мощью, творящие {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} слово, слушаясь звука {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} слова.
ru.B: Благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, вы, {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ангелы, могучие воины, которые исполняют то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорит, и внимают звуку {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} слова.
ru.R: Ангелы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}! Вы сильны и могучи. Вы делаете то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорит. Вы исполняете каждое {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} слово.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ、その方の使いたちよ、力ある勇士たち、その方の言葉を行い、その方の言葉の声に聞き従う者たちよ。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ、その方の使いたちよ。その方の言われることを行い、その言葉の声に耳を傾ける、力ある勇士たちよ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の天使たちよ、その方をほめたたえよ！あなたたちは強く、力に満ちている。あなたたちは、その方の言われることを行い、その方のどんな言葉にも従う。

uk.L: Благословіть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ангели, могутні силою, що виконуєте {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слово, слухаючи голосу {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слова.
uk.B: Благословіть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, ви, {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ангели, сильні воїни, що виконуєте те, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} каже, і прислухаєтеся до звуку {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слова.
uk.R: Ангели {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}! Ви сильні й могутні. Ви робите те, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} каже. Ви слухаєтеся кожного {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слова.

decisions.choice: his angels: his messengers
decisions.reason: The word (mal'akh) means a messenger; God's messengers in heaven are his angels (91:11).

decisions.choice: mighty in strength: strong warriors
decisions.reason: The word (gibbor) is a warrior, a hero; the angels are the strong ones of God's army (verse 21).

decisions.choice: the call goes out to all
decisions.reason: Having called on himself (verses 1-2), the psalmist calls on the angels, the armies of heaven, and all that God has made (verses 20-22).

decisions.choice: praise him
decisions.reason: As in 103:1, Readable says "praise" for blessing God.

decisions.choice: "स्वर्गदूत"
decisions.reason: The word means messengers, here God's heavenly ones (meaning m1); "स्वर्गदूत" is the New Testament's word for God's angels (Hebrews 1:7, 14).

decisions.choice: mal'akhaw "その方の使いたち" (L, B), "天使たち" (R); the call "ほめたたえよ" at every level, R too
decisions.reason: His messengers (m1), as Psalm 91:11 (使いたち L, B; 天使たち R). The call goes out beyond God's people (m3), so R keeps 〜よ as the Psalter's calls to creation.

source.text: בָּרֲכ֣וּ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־צְבָאָ֑יו מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו עֹשֵׂ֥י רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Bless YHWH, all his hosts, his servants, doing his will.

en.L: Bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hosts, \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants who do {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will.
en.B: Bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} armies, \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} attendants who carry out what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants.
en.R: All the armies of heaven, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q You serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants.

fr.L: Bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} armées, \q {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs qui faites {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté.
fr.B: Bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} armées, \q {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs qui accomplissez ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut.
fr.R: Vous toutes, armées du ciel, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! \q Vous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servez et vous faites ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut.

sw.L: Mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, majeshi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yote, watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mnaotenda mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, majeshi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yote, wahudumu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mnaotekeleza anachotaka.
sw.R: Enyi majeshi yote ya mbinguni, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Mnamtumikia na kufanya anachotaka.

es.L: {{plural_you:Bendigan|Bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ejércitos, \q {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos que hacen {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad.
es.B: {{plural_you:Bendigan|Bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ejércitos, \q {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} servidores que cumplen lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiere.
es.R: Todos los ejércitos del cielo, ¡{{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! \q {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:sirven|servís}} y {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiere.

vi.L: Hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi tất cả các đạo quân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, làm theo ý muốn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi tất cả các đạo binh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi những người hầu cận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là những đấng thực hiện điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn.
vi.R: Hỡi tất cả các đạo binh trên trời, hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Các vị phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và làm theo điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라, 그분의 모든 군대야, 그분의 뜻을 행하는 그분의 종들아.
ko.B: 그분의 모든 군대야, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라. 그분께서 원하시는 것을 이루는 그분의 시종들아.
ko.R: 하늘의 모든 군대야, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라! 너희는 그분을 섬기며 그분께서 원하시는 일을 한다.

pt.L: Bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} exércitos, \q os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servidores que fazem a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vontade.
pt.B: Bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, todos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} exércitos, \q os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servidores que realizam o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deseja.
pt.R: Todos os exércitos do céu, louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}! \q Vocês servem a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} e fazem o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quer.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ፣ እናንተ ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ፣ ፈቃዱን የምታደርጉ አገልጋዮቹ።
am.B: እናንተ ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ፣ የሚፈልገውን የምትፈጽሙ አገልጋዮቹ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ።
am.R: እናንተ የሰማይ ሠራዊት ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመስግኑ! ታገለግሉታላችሁ፤ የሚፈልገውንም ታደርጋላችሁ።

hi.L: हे उनकी सब सेनाओ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो, हे उनके सेवको, जो उनकी इच्छा पूरी करते हो।
hi.B: हे उनकी सारी सेनाओ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो, हे उनके सेवको, जो वही करते हो जो वे चाहते हैं।
hi.R: हे स्वर्ग की सारी सेनाओ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करो! तुम उनकी सेवा करते हो और वही करते हो जो वे चाहते हैं।

ru.L: Благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, все {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} воинства, {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} служители, творящие то, что {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} угодно.
ru.B: Благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, все {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} войска, {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} слуги, которые делают то, чего {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} хочет.
ru.R: Все небесные войска, хвалите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}! Вы служите {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} и делаете то, чего {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} хочет.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ、その方のすべての軍勢よ、その方に仕え、そのみこころを行う者たちよ。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ、その方のすべての軍勢よ。その方に仕え、そのみこころを行う者たちよ。
ja.R: 天のすべての軍勢よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ！あなたたちは、その方に仕え、その方の望まれることを行う。

uk.L: Благословіть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, усі {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} воїнства, {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слуги, що виконуєте {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} волю.
uk.B: Благословіть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, усі {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} війська, {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} служителі, що чините те, чого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} бажає.
uk.R: Усі небесні війська, хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}! Ви служите {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} й робите те, чого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} хоче.

decisions.choice: his hosts: the armies of heaven
decisions.reason: The hosts (tseva'ot) are God's armies in heaven, his angels and the stars (148:2; 1 Kings 22:19), the word in the title "the LORD of hosts".

decisions.choice: his servants: those who attend him
decisions.reason: The word (meshartim) is used of attendants who wait on a king and of priests who serve in the temple.

decisions.choice: armies
decisions.reason: As with the title "the LORD of Armies", Balanced and Readable say "armies"; Literal keeps the older "hosts".

decisions.choice: praise the LORD
"ses serviteurs" at every level for God's heavenly attendants
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word here (mesharet) is not ʿeved; it names attendants who serve in a king's presence, so "serviteurs" fits at every level.

decisions.choice: his hosts (tsevaʾot) "ሠራዊቱ"
decisions.reason: The same word as in "የሠራዊት አምላክ", the Balanced and Readable form of the title "the LORD of hosts", so the link the meaning decision draws can be heard.

decisions.choice: "सेवक"
decisions.reason: The word here is not 'eved but a word for those who attend on someone (meaning m2), so it is "सेवक", the word for service, not "दास".

decisions.choice: "воинства" (L); "войска" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The armies of heaven (m1): Literal keeps the older "воинства", Balanced and Readable say "войска", as the English moves from "hosts" to "armies" and as the history note has "Воинств" at Readable.

decisions.choice: tseva'aw "その方の軍勢" (L, B), "天のすべての軍勢" (R); retsono "みこころ" (L, B)
decisions.reason: His hosts are the armies of heaven (m1); his will is what he wants, みこころ as Hebrews 10:7 (Psalm 40:9).

source.text: בָּרֲכ֤וּ יְהוָ֨ה׀כָּֽל־מַעֲשָׂ֗יו בְּכָל־מְקֹמ֥וֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֑וֹ בָּרֲכִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Bless YHWH, all his works, in all places of his dominion. Bless, my soul, YHWH.

en.L: Bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} works, in all places of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} dominion. \q Bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, my soul.
en.B: Bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made, everywhere under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rule. \q Bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, my soul.
en.R: Everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has made, praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in every place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rules! \q With all that I am, I praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} œuvres, dans tous les lieux de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} domination. \q Bénis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mon âme.
fr.B: Bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait, partout où s’étend {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} règne. \q Mon âme, bénis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Vous tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait, louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} partout où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} règne ! \q De tout mon être, je loue {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote, mahali pote pa utawala {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Mbariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nafsi yangu.
sw.B: Mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, vyote alivyoviumba, kila mahali chini ya utawala {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Nafsi yangu, mbariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Vyote alivyoviumba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, msifuni kila mahali anapotawala! Kwa moyo wangu wote ninamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Bendigan|Bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} obras, en todos los lugares de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} dominio. \q Bendice {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, alma mía.
es.B: {{plural_you:Bendigan|Bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho, en todas partes bajo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} dominio. \q Bendice {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, alma mía.
es.R: Todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho, ¡{{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}} en todo lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} gobierna! \q Con todo lo que soy, alabo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi mọi công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, trong mọi nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cai trị. Hỡi linh hồn tôi, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi mọi vật {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên, ở khắp mọi nơi dưới quyền cai trị của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hỡi linh hồn tôi, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Hỡi mọi vật {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dựng nên, hãy ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở mọi nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cai trị! Với cả con người mình, tôi ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라, 그분께서 지으신 모든 것들아, 그분께서 다스리시는 모든 곳에서. 내 영혼아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라.
ko.B: 그분께서 지으신 모든 것들아, 그분의 통치 아래 있는 모든 곳에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라. 내 영혼아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 만드신 모든 것들아, 그분께서 다스리시는 모든 곳에서 그분을 찬양하여라! 나는 온 마음을 다해 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양한다.

pt.L: Bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, todas as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} obras, em todos os lugares do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} domínio. \q Bendiga {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, minha alma.
pt.B: Bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, todas as coisas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez, em todo lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} governa. \q Minha alma, bendiga {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Tudo o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez, louve-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} em todo lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} reina! \q Com tudo o que eu sou, eu louvo {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: እናንተ ሥራዎቹ ሁሉ፣ በግዛቱ ስፍራ ሁሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ። ነፍሴ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኪ።
am.B: እናንተ የሠራቸው ሁሉ፣ በግዛቱ ሥር ባለው ስፍራ ሁሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኩ። ነፍሴ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ባርኪ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሠራቸው ፍጥረታት ሁሉ፣ በሚገዛበት ስፍራ ሁሉ አመስግኑት! በሙሉ ሁለንተናዬ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመሰግናለሁ።

hi.L: हे उनकी सब रचनाओ, उनके राज्य के सब स्थानों में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो। हे मेरे प्राण, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो।
hi.B: हे उनकी बनाई हुई सब वस्तुओ, उनके राज्य में हर जगह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो। हे मेरे प्राण, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहो।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की बनाई हुई हर चीज़, हर उस जगह जहाँ वे राज्य करते हैं, उनकी स्तुति करो! मैं पूरे मन से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करता हूँ।

ru.L: Благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, все {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} создания, во всех местах, где {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} владычествует. Душа моя, благослови {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Благословите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, все {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} творения, повсюду, где {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} правит. Душа моя, благослови {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Всё, что создал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} повсюду, где {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} правит! Всем своим существом я хвалю {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ、その方のすべてのわざよ、その方の支配のあらゆる所で。わたしの魂よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ、その方の造られたすべてのものよ、その方の治められるあらゆる所で。わたしの魂よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が造られたすべてのものよ、その方が治められるあらゆる所で、その方をほめたたえよ！わたしは心から{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよう。

uk.L: Благословіть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, усі {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} творіння, у всіх місцях {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} панування. Благослови, душе моя, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Благословіть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, усе, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} створив, усюди під {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} владою. Душе моя, благослови {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Усе, що створив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} в кожному місці, де {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} панує! Усім своїм єством я хвалю {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: the psalm ends as it began
decisions.reason: The last line repeats the first (verse 1): the call to all creation comes back to the psalmist's own praise.

decisions.choice: his works: all he has made
decisions.reason: All God's works, everything he has made, are called to praise him (145:10; 148).

decisions.choice: With all that I am, I praise the LORD
decisions.reason: As in 103:1.

decisions.choice: praise him
the closing line in the words of verse 1
decisions.reason: The psalm ends as it began (meaning m1), so the Hindi repeats verse 1's wording at each level.
